purpose: Local reviewer calibration for the grammar, blank-inference, and cross-type evidence contracts. It is not a generation experiment or a production-quality result.

composition.authorStratumRule: Author strata are construction hypotheses only. They are never shown to calibration reviewers and do not become gold without two independent reviews and fresh adjudication.

rightsAndPrivacy.permittedUse: Local reviewer calibration for question-quality research in this campaign only.
rightsAndPrivacy.piiRule: Each row carries a manual no-PII attestation and the builder applies conservative pattern scans.

blinding.phase1: Reviewer-specific deterministic item order and answer-label permutation expose only the exact student surface.
blinding.phase1Seal: The complete phase-1 response is hashed and sealed before reveal.
blinding.phase2: Only after a valid phase-1 seal, disclose the authorized source binding, stored key, explanation, and scoring contract under the same pseudonyms.
blinding.perItemBindings: Every post-reveal review binds the issued surface hash, its exact relabel-map-row hash, and its own sealed phase-one answer-record hash; cross-item hash reuse is rejected.
blinding.timestampRule: All persisted timestamps must be real RFC3339 instants with at most microsecond precision; invalid calendar dates and non-increasing issuance/expiry order are rejected.

metricConventions.comparator: Each reviewer is scored independently against immutable adjudicated gold; pair consensus is forbidden.
metricConventions.thresholdComparison: Compare unrounded rational values. Display rounding is non-operative.
metricConventions.fatalClass: grade F or finalGold.anyFatal=true; adjudicated gold must make these equivalent.
metricConventions.gwetAc1: Binary two-rater AC1 using pooled positive marginal p=(gold positives + review positives)/(2n), chance agreement=2p(1-p), AC1=(observed agreement-chance)/(1-chance).
metricConventions.quadraticWeightedKappa: Ordered categories F=0,C=1,B=2,A=3 with disagreement weights ((i-j)/3)^2 and kappa=1-observedWeightedDisagreement/expectedWeightedDisagreement.
metricConventions.grammarSiteAgreement: Gold-equal atomic values across displayedGrammaticality, diagnosis, pointFamily, correctionRestoresSource, and explanationAccurate for each of five sites.
metricConventions.blankOptionAgreement: Gold-equal atomic values across slotGrammarCompatible, passageGrounded, primaryIntentAxis, divergentAxes, and singleDecisiveFlaw for each of five options.
metricConventions.blankAxisAgreement: Gold-equal answerPreserved values across actorOrTarget, polarity, conditionOrModality, causalRelationAndDirection, scopeOrQuantifier, stance, and temporalRelation.
metricConventions.decisionArithmetic: Every gate compares exact integer numerator/denominator pairs by cross multiplication. Decimal values are reporting-only.
metricConventions.blindSolveGate: Blind-solve exact agreement is a non-compensatory V6 certificate gate globally and within every block.

certificateScope.nonfocusScope: Evidence-family familiarity only. Passing does not certify unobserved type-specific expertise for all 23 nonfocus types.

executionHold: No reviewer may be certified while gold status is pending, any required record is missing, packet/oracle/contract/scorer hashes differ, or truthful adjudicated gold makes the packet composition ineligible. The final-gold schema stores actual judgments without forcing the planned 2F/2C/2B/2A distribution; only certificate issuance applies PACKET_COMPOSITION_INELIGIBLE.
